verses.text: E come be say on di day wey Moses don finish set up di tabernacle, and don anoint am and make am holy, and all im furniture, and di altar and all im vessels, and don anoint dem and make dem holy,
di princes of Israel, di heads of dem papa houses, wey be di princes of di tribes, wey dey over dem wey dem number, make offering.
Dem bring dem offering before di Lord: six covered wagons, and 12 oxen, one wagon for two of di princes, and for each one one ox. Dem present dem before di tabernacle.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Take dem from dem, so that dem go dey used for di service of di Tent of Meeting, and give dem to di Levites, to every man according to im service.”
Moses take di wagons and di oxen, and give dem to di Levites.
Two wagons and four oxen e give to di pikin dem of Gershon, according to dem service.
Four wagons and eight oxen e give to di pikin dem of Merari, according to dem service, under di hand of Ithamar di pikin of Aaron di priest.
But to di pikin dem of Kohath e no give any, because di service of di holy things belong to dem. Dem dey carry am on dem shoulders.
Di princes offer for di dedication of di altar for di day wey e dey anointed. Di princes offer dem offering before di altar.
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Dem go offer dem offering, one prince each day, for di dedication of di altar.”
Na im wey offer im offering di first day na Nahshon di pikin of Amminadab, of di tribe of Judah.
Im offering na one silver platter, di weight of am 130 shekels, one silver bowl of 70 shekels, after di shekel of di sanctuary. Both of dem full of fine flour mixed with oil for one meal offering,
one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense,
one young bull, one ram, one male lamb of di first year, for burnt offering,
one male goat for sin offering,
and for di sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs of di first year. Dis na di offering of Nahshon di pikin of Amminadab.
For di second day, Nethanel di pikin of Zuar, prince of di pikin dem of Issachar, offer.

E offer for im offering one silver platter, di weight of am 130 shekels, one silver bowl of 70 shekels, after di shekel of di sanctuary. Both of dem full of fine flour mixed with oil for one meal offering,
one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense,
one young bull, one ram, one male lamb of di first year, for burnt offering,
one male goat for sin offering,
and for di sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs of di first year. Dis na di offering of Nethanel di pikin of Zuar.
For di third day, Eliab di pikin of Helon, prince of di pikin dem of Zebulun, offer.

E offer for im offering one silver platter, di weight of am 130 shekels, one silver bowl of 70 shekels, after di shekel of di sanctuary. Both of dem full of fine flour mixed with oil for one meal offering,
one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense,
one young bull, one ram, one male lamb of di first year, for burnt offering,
one male goat for sin offering,
and for di sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs of di first year. Dis na di offering of Eliab di pikin of Helon.
For di fourth day, Elizur di pikin of Shedeur, prince of di pikin dem of Reuben, offer.

E offer for im offering one silver platter, di weight of am 130 shekels, one silver bowl of 70 shekels, after di shekel of di sanctuary. Both of dem full of fine flour mixed with oil for one meal offering,
one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense,
one young bull, one ram, one male lamb of di first year, for burnt offering,
one male goat for sin offering,
and for di sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs of di first year. Dis na di offering of Elizur di pikin of Shedeur.
For di fifth day, Shelumiel di pikin of Zurishaddai, prince of di pikin dem of Simeon, offer.

E offer for im offering one silver platter, di weight of am 130 shekels, one silver bowl of 70 shekels, after di shekel of di sanctuary. Both of dem full of fine flour mixed with oil for one meal offering,
one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense,
one young bull, one ram, one male lamb of di first year, for burnt offering,
one male goat for sin offering,
and for di sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs of di first year. Dis na di offering of Shelumiel di pikin of Zurishaddai.
For di sixth day, Eliasaph di pikin of Deuel, prince of di pikin dem of Gad, offer.

E offer for im offering one silver platter, di weight of am 130 shekels, one silver bowl of 70 shekels, after di shekel of di sanctuary. Both of dem full of fine flour mixed with oil for one meal offering,
one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense,
one young bull, one ram, one male lamb of di first year, for burnt offering,
one male goat for sin offering,
and for di sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs of di first year. Dis na di offering of Eliasaph di pikin of Deuel.
For di seventh day, Elishama di pikin of Ammihud, prince of di pikin dem of Ephraim, offer.

E offer for im offering one silver platter, di weight of am 130 shekels, one silver bowl of 70 shekels, after di shekel of di sanctuary. Both of dem full of fine flour mixed with oil for one meal offering,
one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense,
one young bull, one ram, one male lamb of di first year, for burnt offering,
one male goat for sin offering,
and for di sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs of di first year. Dis na di offering of Elishama di pikin of Ammihud.
For di eighth day, Gamaliel di pikin of Pedahzur, prince of di pikin dem of Manasseh, offer.

E offer for im offering one silver platter, di weight of am 130 shekels, one silver bowl of 70 shekels, after di shekel of di sanctuary. Both of dem full of fine flour mixed with oil for one meal offering,
one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense,
one young bull, one ram, one male lamb of di first year, for burnt offering,
one male goat for sin offering,
and for di sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs of di first year. Dis na di offering of Gamaliel di pikin of Pedahzur.
For di ninth day, Abidan di pikin of Gideoni, prince of di pikin dem of Benjamin, offer.

E offer for im offering one silver platter, di weight of am 130 shekels, one silver bowl of 70 shekels, after di shekel of di sanctuary. Both of dem full of fine flour mixed with oil for one meal offering,
one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense,
one young bull, one ram, one male lamb of di first year, for burnt offering,
one male goat for sin offering,
and for di sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs of di first year. Dis na di offering of Abidan di pikin of Gideoni.
For di tenth day, Ahiezer di pikin of Ammishaddai, prince of di pikin dem of Dan, offer.

E offer for im offering one silver platter, di weight of am 130 shekels, one silver bowl of 70 shekels, after di shekel of di sanctuary. Both of dem full of fine flour mixed with oil for one meal offering,
one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense,
one young bull, one ram, one male lamb of di first year, for burnt offering,
one male goat for sin offering,
and for di sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs of di first year. Dis na di offering of Ahiezer di pikin of Ammishaddai.
For di 11th day, Pagiel di pikin of Ochran, prince of di pikin dem of Asher, offer.

E offer for im offering one silver platter, di weight of am 130 shekels, one silver bowl of 70 shekels, after di shekel of di sanctuary. Both of dem full of fine flour mixed with oil for one meal offering,
one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense,
one young bull, one ram, one male lamb of di first year, for burnt offering,
one male goat for sin offering,
and for di sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs of di first year. Dis na di offering of Pagiel di pikin of Ochran.
For di 12th day, Ahira di pikin of Enan, prince of di pikin dem of Naphtali, offer.

E offer for im offering one silver platter, di weight of am 130 shekels, one silver bowl of 70 shekels, after di shekel of di sanctuary. Both of dem full of fine flour mixed with oil for one meal offering,
one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense,
one young bull, one ram, one male lamb of di first year, for burnt offering,
one male goat for sin offering,
and for di sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs of di first year. Dis na di offering of Ahira di pikin of Enan.
Dis na di dedication of di altar, for di day wey e dey anointed, from di princes of Israel: 12 silver platters, 12 silver bowls, 12 golden spoons.
Each silver platter weigh 130 shekels, and each bowl 70. All di silver of di vessels na 2,400 shekels, after di shekel of di sanctuary.
Di 12 golden spoons, full of incense, weigh ten shekels each, after di shekel of di sanctuary. All di gold of di spoons na 120 shekels.
All di oxen for di burnt offering na 12 bulls, di rams 12, di male lambs of di first year 12, with dem meal offering. Di male goats for sin offering na 12.
All di oxen for di sacrifice of peace offerings na 24 bulls, di rams 60, di male goats 60, di male lambs of di first year 60. Dis na di dedication of di altar, after e dey anointed.
When Moses go into di Tent of Meeting to speak with di Lord, e hear di Voice speaking to am from above di mercy seat wey dey on di ark of di testimony, from between di two cherubim. E speak to am.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to Aaron, and tell am, ‘When you light di lamps, di seven lamps go give light in front of di lampstand.’”
Aaron do so. E light im lamps to face di front of di lampstand, as di Lord command Moses.
Dis na di work of di lampstand, beaten work of gold. From im base to im flowers, e na beaten work. According to di pattern wey di Lord show Moses, so e make di lampstand.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Take di Levites from among di pikin dem of Israel, and cleanse dem.
Do dis to dem to cleanse dem: sprinkle di water of purification on dem, and make dem shave all dem flesh, and make dem wash dem clothes, and cleanse demself.
Make dem take one young bull, with im meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You go take another young bull for sin offering.
You go bring di Levites before di Tent of Meeting. You go gather all di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel together.
You go bring di Levites before di Lord. Di pikin dem of Israel go lay dem hands on di Levites.
Aaron go offer di Levites before di Lord for wave offering from di pikin dem of Israel, so that dem go do di service of di Lord.
Di Levites go lay dem hands on di heads of di bulls. You go offer di one for sin offering, and di other for burnt offering, to di Lord, to make atonement for di Levites.
You go set di Levites before Aaron, and before im pikin man dem, and offer dem for wave offering to di Lord.
Na so you go separate di Levites from among di pikin dem of Israel, and di Levites go be mine.
After dat di Levites go go in to do di service of di Tent of Meeting. You go cleanse dem, and offer dem for wave offering.
Because dem dey wholly given to me from among di pikin dem of Israel. Instead of all dat open di womb, even di firstborn of all di pikin dem of Israel, I don take dem to myself.
Because all di firstborn among di pikin dem of Israel na mine, both man and animal. For di day wey I strike all di firstborn for di land of Egypt, I make dem holy for myself.
I don take di Levites instead of all di firstborn among di pikin dem of Israel.

I don give di Levites as gift to Aaron and to im pikin man dem from among di pikin dem of Israel, to do di service of di pikin dem of Israel for di Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for di pikin dem of Israel, so that no plague go dey among di pikin dem of Israel, when di pikin dem of Israel come near to di sanctuary.”
Moses, and Aaron, and all di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel, do to di Levites according to all wey di Lord command Moses concerning di Levites. Na so di pikin dem of Israel do to dem.
Di Levites purify demself from sin, and dem wash dem clothes. Aaron offer dem for wave offering before di Lord, and Aaron make atonement for dem to cleanse dem.
After dat di Levites go in to do dem service for di Tent of Meeting before Aaron, and before im pikin man dem. As di Lord command Moses concerning di Levites, so dem do to dem.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Dis na wetin belong to di Levites: from 25 years old and above dem go go in to perform di service for di work of di Tent of Meeting.
From di age of 50 years dem go cease performing di work, and go serve no more,
but dem go minister with dem brothers for di Tent of Meeting, to keep di charge, and dem go do no service. Na so you go do to di Levites touching dem charge.”
Di Lord speak to Moses for di wilderness of Sinai, for di first month of di second year after dem come out of di land of Egypt, talk,
“Also make di pikin dem of Israel keep di Passover for im appointed season.
For di 14th day of dis month, between di two evenings, una go keep am for im appointed season. According to all im statutes, and according to all im ordinances, una go keep am.”
Moses speak to di pikin dem of Israel, say make dem keep di Passover.
Dem keep di Passover for di first month, on di 14th day of di month, between di two evenings, for di wilderness of Sinai. According to all wey di Lord command Moses, so di pikin dem of Israel do.
Dere dey certain men, wey dey unclean by di dead body of one man, so that dem no fit keep di Passover on dat day. Dem come before Moses and before Aaron on dat day.
Dem talk to am, “We dey unclean by di dead body of one man. Why dem go keep us back, so that we no go offer di offering of di Lord for im appointed season among di pikin dem of Israel?”
Moses talk to dem, “Wait, make I hear wetin di Lord go command concerning una.”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, talk, ‘If any man of una or of una posterity dey unclean by reason of one dead body, or dey for one journey far away, e go still keep di Passover to di Lord.
For di second month on di 14th day between di two evenings dem go keep am. Dem go eat am with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
Dem go leave none of am until morning, nor break any bone of am. According to all di statute of di Passover dem go keep am.

But di man wey dey clean, and no dey on one journey, and fail to keep di Passover, dat soul go dey cut off from im people, because e no offer di offering of di Lord for im appointed season. Dat man go bear im sin.

If one stranger dey sojourn among una, and keep di Passover to di Lord, e go do am according to di statute of di Passover, and according to im ordinance. Una go get one statute, both for di stranger and for di native.’”
For di day wey dem set up di tabernacle, di cloud cover di tabernacle, di Tent of di testimony. From evening until morning e dey over di tabernacle like di appearance of fire.
Na so e dey always. Di cloud cover am by day, and di appearance of fire by night.
Whenever di cloud dey taken up from di Tent, after dat di pikin dem of Israel go journey. For di place wia di cloud stay, dere di pikin dem of Israel go encamp.
At di commandment of di Lord di pikin dem of Israel go journey, and at di commandment of di Lord dem go encamp. As long as di cloud stay on di tabernacle dem go encamp.
When di cloud go stay on di tabernacle many days, di pikin dem of Israel go keep di charge of di Lord, and no go journey.
Sometimes di cloud dey few days on di tabernacle. Dem go encamp according to di commandment of di Lord, and according to di commandment of di Lord dem go journey.
Sometimes di cloud dey from evening until morning. When di cloud dey taken up for morning, dem go journey. Or whether by day or by night, when di cloud dey taken up, dem go journey.
Whether two days, or one month, or one year, wey di cloud stay on di tabernacle, remain on am, di pikin dem of Israel go remain encamped, and no go journey. But when e dey taken up, dem go journey.
At di commandment of di Lord dem encamp, and at di commandment of di Lord dem journey. Dem keep di charge of di Lord, at di commandment of di Lord by di hand of Moses.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Make for yourself two silver trumpets. Of beaten work you go make dem. You go use dem for calling di congregation, and for di journeying of di camps.
When dem blow dem, all di congregation go gather demself to you, at di door of di Tent of Meeting.
If dem blow but one, di princes, di heads of di thousands of Israel, go gather demself to you.
When una blow one alarm, di camps wey dey pitch on di east side go go forward.
When una blow one alarm di second time, di camps wey dey pitch on di south side go set out. Dem go blow one alarm for dem journeys.
But when di assembly dey gathered together, una go blow, but una no go sound one alarm.
Di pikin man dem of Aaron, di priests, go blow di trumpets. Dem go be to una for one statute forever throughout una generations.
When una go to war for una land against di adversary wey oppress una, una go sound one alarm with di trumpets. Una go dey remembered before di Lord una God, and una go dey saved from una enemies.

Also for di day of una gladness, and for una set feasts, and for di beginnings of una months, una go blow di trumpets over una burnt offerings, and over di sacrifices of una peace offerings. Dem go be to una for one memorial before una God. I na di Lord una God.”
E come be say for di second year, for di second month, on di 20th day of di month, di cloud dey taken up from over di tabernacle of di testimony.
Di pikin dem of Israel set out on dem journeys out of di wilderness of Sinai. Di cloud rest for di wilderness of Paran.
Dem first set out according to di commandment of di Lord by di hand of Moses.
Di standard of di camp of di pikin dem of Judah set out first according to dem armies. Over im army na Nahshon di pikin of Amminadab.
Over di army of di tribe of di pikin dem of Issachar na Nethanel di pikin of Zuar.
Over di army of di tribe of di pikin dem of Zebulun na Eliab di pikin of Helon.
Di tabernacle dey taken down, and di pikin dem of Gershon and di pikin dem of Merari set out, wey dey carry di tabernacle.
Di standard of di camp of Reuben set out according to dem armies. Over im army na Elizur di pikin of Shedeur.
Over di army of di tribe of di pikin dem of Simeon na Shelumiel di pikin of Zurishaddai.
Over di army of di tribe of di pikin dem of Gad na Eliasaph di pikin of Deuel.
Di Kohathites set out, wey dey carry di sanctuary. Di others go set up di tabernacle before dem come.
Di standard of di camp of di pikin dem of Ephraim set out according to dem armies. Over im army na Elishama di pikin of Ammihud.
Over di army of di tribe of di pikin dem of Manasseh na Gamaliel di pikin of Pedahzur.
Over di army of di tribe of di pikin dem of Benjamin na Abidan di pikin of Gideoni.
Di standard of di camp of di pikin dem of Dan, wey be di rear guard of all di camps, set out according to dem armies. Over im army na Ahiezer di pikin of Ammishaddai.
Over di army of di tribe of di pikin dem of Asher na Pagiel di pikin of Ochran.
Over di army of di tribe of di pikin dem of Naphtali na Ahira di pikin of Enan.
Dis na di order of march of di pikin dem of Israel according to dem armies, when dem set out.

Moses talk to Hobab, di pikin of Reuel di Midianite, Moses wife papa, “We dey journey to di place wey di Lord talk about, say, ‘I go give am to una.’ Come with us, and we go do you good, because di Lord don speak good concerning Israel.”
E talk to am, “I no go go. I go depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”
Moses talk, “No leave us, because you know how we go encamp for di wilderness, and you go be our eyes.
E go be say, if you go with us, wetin good wey di Lord go do to us, di same go we do to you.”
Dem set out from di mountain of di Lord three days journey. Di ark of di covenant of di Lord go before dem three days journey, to seek one resting place for dem.
Di cloud of di Lord dey over dem by day, when dem set out from di camp.
E come be say, when di ark set out, Moses talk, “Rise up, Lord, and make your enemies dey scattered. Make dem wey hate you flee before you.”
When e rest, e talk, “Return, Lord, to di ten thousands of thousands of Israel.”
Di people complain, and e dey evil for di ears of di Lord. When di Lord hear am, im anger dey kindled. Di fire of di Lord burn among dem, and consume some of di outermost parts of di camp.
Di people cry to Moses. Moses pray to di Lord, and di fire abate.
E call di name of dat place Taberah, because di fire of di Lord burn among dem.
Di mixed multitude wey dey among dem begin to lust. Di pikin dem of Israel too weep again, and talk, “Who go give us meat to eat?
We remember di fish, wey we dey eat free for Egypt, di cucumbers, di melons, di leeks, di onions, and di garlic,
but now our soul dey dried up. Dere no dey anything at all except dis manna to look at.”
Di manna dey like coriander seed, and im appearance like bdellium.
Di people go about, and gather am, and grind am for mills, or beat am for mortars, and boil am for pots, and make cakes of am. Im taste na like di taste of fresh oil.
When di dew fall on di camp for night, di manna fall on am.
Moses hear di people weeping throughout dem families, every man for di door of im tent. Di anger of di Lord dey kindled greatly, and Moses dey displeased.
Moses talk to di Lord, “Why you don treat your servant so badly? Why I no find favour for your sight, say you lay di burden of all dis people on me?
I don conceive all dis people? I don born dem, say you talk to me, ‘Carry dem for your bosom, as one nurse carry one nursing pikin, to di land wey you swear to dem papa dem’?
Wia I go get meat to give to all dis people? Because dem weep to me, talk, ‘Give us meat, make we eat.’
I no fit bear all dis people alone, because e too heavy for me.
If you go deal with me like dis, kill me right now, if I don find favour for your sight, and make I no see my wretchedness.”

Di Lord talk to Moses, “Gather to me 70 men of di elders of Israel, wey you know say dem na di elders of di people, and officers over dem. Bring dem to di Tent of Meeting, and make dem stand dere with you.
I go come down and talk with you dere. I go take of di Spirit wey dey upon you, and go put am upon dem. Dem go bear di burden of di people with you, so that you no go bear am yourself alone.

Say to di people, ‘Make yourselves holy against tomorrow, and una go eat meat, because una don weep for di ears of di Lord, say who go give una meat to eat, say e don dey well with una for Egypt. Therefore di Lord go give una meat, and una go eat.
Una go eat, no be one day, nor two days, nor five days, nor ten days, nor 20 days,
but even one whole month, until e come out of una nostrils, and e become loathsome to una, because una don reject di Lord wey dey among una, and don weep before am, say why una come out of Egypt.’”
Moses talk, “Di people, among wey I dey, na 600,000 men on foot, and you don talk, ‘I go give dem meat, so that dem go eat one whole month.’
Dem go kill flocks and herds for dem, to dey enough for dem? Or dem go gather all di fish of di sea together for dem, to dey enough for dem?”
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Di Lord hand don shorten? Now you go see whether my word go come to pass for you or no.”
Moses go out, and tell di people di words of di Lord. E gather 70 men of di elders of di people, and set dem round about di Tent.
Di Lord come down for di cloud, and speak to am, and take of di Spirit wey dey upon am, and put am upon di 70 elders. When di Spirit rest on dem, dem prophesy, but dem no continue.

But two of di men remain for di camp. Di name of one na Eldad, and di name of di other na Medad. Di Spirit rest on dem. Dem na among dem wey dem write, but dem no go out to di Tent. Dem prophesy for di camp.
One young man run, and tell Moses, and talk, “Eldad and Medad dey prophesy for di camp.”
Joshua di pikin of Nun, di servant of Moses, one of im chosen men, answer, “My oga Moses, forbid dem.”
Moses talk to am, “You dey jealous for my sake? I wish say all di Lord people na prophets, say di Lord go put im Spirit upon dem!”
Moses go back to di camp, e and di elders of Israel.

One wind go out from di Lord, and bring quails from di sea, and let dem fall by di camp, about one day journey on dis side, and one day journey on di other side, round about di camp, and about two cubits above di surface of di earth.
Di people rise up all dat day, and all di night, and all di next day, and gather di quails. Im wey gather least gather ten homers. Dem spread dem all abroad for demself round about di camp.
While di meat still dey between dem teeth, before e dey chewed, di anger of di Lord dey kindled against di people, and di Lord strike di people with one very great plague.
Dem call di name of dat place Kibroth Hattaavah, because dere dem bury di people wey lust.
From Kibroth Hattaavah di people journey to Hazeroth, and dem stay for Hazeroth.
Miriam and Aaron speak against Moses because of di Cushite woman wey e don marry, because e don marry one Cushite woman.
Dem talk, “Di Lord don speak only by Moses? E no speak by us too?” Di Lord hear am.
Now di man Moses dey very humble, more than all di men wey dey on di surface of di earth.
Di Lord speak suddenly to Moses, and to Aaron, and to Miriam, “Come out una three to di Tent of Meeting.” Di three of dem come out.
Di Lord come down for di pillar of cloud, and stand for di door of di Tent, and call Aaron and Miriam. Dem two come out.
E talk, “Hear now my words. If dere dey one prophet among una, I, di Lord, go make myself known to am for vision. I go speak with am for dream.
My servant Moses no be so. E dey faithful for all my house.
With am I speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and no for riddles, and e see di form of di Lord. Why una no dey afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”
Di anger of di Lord dey kindled against dem, and e depart.
Di cloud depart from over di Tent, and look, Miriam dey leprous, white as snow. Aaron look at Miriam, and look, e dey leprous.
Aaron talk to Moses, “Oh my oga, no lay sin on us, because we don do foolishly, and we don sin.
Make am no be like one dead pikin, wey im flesh dey half consumed when e come out of im mama womb.”
Moses cry to di Lord, talk, “Heal am now, God.”
Di Lord talk to Moses, “If im papa spit for im face, e no for dey ashamed seven days? Make am dey shut up outside di camp seven days, and after dat make dem bring am in again.”
Miriam dey shut up outside di camp seven days. Di people no journey until Miriam dey brought in again.
After dat di people journey from Hazeroth, and encamp for di wilderness of Paran.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Send men, so that dem go spy out di land of Canaan, wey I give to di pikin dem of Israel. Of every tribe of dem papa dem una go send one man, every one one prince among dem.”
Moses send dem from di wilderness of Paran according to di commandment of di Lord. All dem men na heads of di pikin dem of Israel.
Dem na dem names: Of di tribe of Reuben, Shammua di pikin of Zaccur.
Of di tribe of Simeon, Shaphat di pikin of Hori.
Of di tribe of Judah, Caleb di pikin of Jephunneh.
Of di tribe of Issachar, Igal di pikin of Joseph.
Of di tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea di pikin of Nun.
Of di tribe of Benjamin, Palti di pikin of Raphu.
Of di tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel di pikin of Sodi.
Of di tribe of Joseph, namely, of di tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi di pikin of Susi.
Of di tribe of Dan, Ammiel di pikin of Gemalli.
Of di tribe of Asher, Sethur di pikin of Michael.
Of di tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi di pikin of Vophsi.
Of di tribe of Gad, Geuel di pikin of Machi.
Dem na di names of di men wey Moses send to spy out di land. Moses call Hoshea di pikin of Nun Joshua.
Moses send dem to spy out di land of Canaan, and talk to dem, “Go up dis way by di South, and go up into di hill country.
See di land, wetin e be, and di people wey dwell inside am, whether dem strong or weak, whether dem few or many.
Wetin di land wey dem dwell inside be, whether e good or bad. Wetin di cities wey dem dwell inside be, whether for camps, or for strongholds.
Wetin di land be, whether e fat or lean, whether trees dey inside am or no. Make una dey of good courage. Bring some of di fruit of di land.” Now di time na di season of di first ripe grapes.
So dem go up, and spy out di land from di wilderness of Zin to Rehob, as men go to Hamath.
Dem go up by di South, and come to Hebron. Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, di descendants of Anak, dey dere. Hebron dem build seven years before Zoan for Egypt.
Dem come to di valley of Eshcol, and cut down from dere one branch with one cluster of grapes, and dem carry am between two on one pole. Dem bring some of di pomegranates and of di figs.
Dat place dem call di valley of Eshcol, because of di cluster wey di pikin dem of Israel cut down from dere.
Dem return from spying out di land at di end of 40 days.

Dem go and come to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel, to di wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh. Dem bring back word to dem, and to all di congregation, and show dem di fruit of di land.
Dem tell am, and talk, “We come to di land wia you send us. Truly e dey flow with milk and honey. Dis na di fruit of am.
However di people wey dwell inside di land dey strong, and di cities dey fortified, and very large. Moreover we see di descendants of Anak dere.
Di Amalekites dwell for di land of di South. Di Hittites, di Jebusites, and di Amorites dwell for di hill country. Di Canaanites dwell by di sea, and along di side of di Jordan.”
Caleb quiet di people before Moses, and talk, “Make we go up at once, and possess am, because we dey well able to overcome am.”
But di men wey go up with am talk, “We no dey able to go up against di people, because dem dey stronger pass us.”

Dem bring up one evil report of di land wey dem don spy out to di pikin dem of Israel, talk, “Di land, through wey we don go to spy am out, na one land wey eat up im inhabitants. All di people wey we see inside am na men of great stature.
Dere we see di Nephilim, di pikin dem of Anak, wey come from di Nephilim. We dey for our own sight like grasshoppers, and so we dey for dem sight.”
